name: Sales Income by Patient
query:
SELECT
    si.posting_date AS "Date:Date:110",
    si.customer AS "Customer ID:Link/Customer:140",
    si.customer_name AS "Customer Name:Data:220",
    si.patient AS "Patient ID:Link/Patient:140",
    si.ref_practitioner AS "Referring Practitioner:Data:180",
    si.net_total AS "Net Income:Currency:130",
    si.total AS "Total:Currency:130",
    si.discount_amount AS "Discount Amount:Currency:130",
    et.mrp AS "ER Category:Data:130"
FROM
    `tabSales Invoice` si
INNER JOIN
    (
        SELECT et1.patient, et1.mrp
        FROM `tabEmergency Triage` et1
        INNER JOIN (
            SELECT patient, MAX(creation) AS max_creation
            FROM `tabEmergency Triage`
            GROUP BY patient
        ) latest
            ON latest.patient = et1.patient
           AND latest.max_creation = et1.creation
    ) et
    ON et.patient = si.patient
WHERE
    si.docstatus = 1
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY
    si.posting_date DESC,
    si.name DESC
